name: Komplyt Zero
description:
Your AI remembers what matters: context, decisions, the way you actually work. It carries that forward, session to  session, tool to tool, keeping everything connected.

Stop explaining your approach and decisions every time. Capture observations, decisions, and problems as you work. Query by meaning, not keywords. Watch connections emerge automatically. Pick up exactly where you left off, even weeks later,  even in a different tool.

Features:
• Semantic search across everything you've captured
• Automatic relationship discovery between ideas
• Session-aware decay scoring; recent context surfaces first
• Spreading activation; find related knowledge through graph traversal
• Works across Claude, Claude Code and other assistants
• EU data residency (Frankfurt)
• GDPR compliant with full data portability

_published_faq.name: How do I add Komplyt Zero to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Komplyt Zero to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://kg.kompl.yt/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Komplyt Zero MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Komplyt Zero provides these MCP tools: kg_query, kg_record, kg_relate, kg_session, kg_status, and kg_update.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Komplyt Zero?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Komplyt Zero in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Komplyt Zero MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Komplyt Zero requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Komplyt Zero is developed by Komplyzen. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
